canonical.title: Tech conferences & IT events in Stavanger, 2026

parent.title: A Stavanger weekend, anchored on RE-NAA

siblings.title: Things to do in Stavanger
siblings.summary: A two-to-three day Stavanger plan around a Michelin-starred dinner: the headline hike, an old-town walking loop, the museum and street-art picks worth the time, and where to eat the rest of the weekend.

siblings.title: Michelin 2 and 3-star restaurants in Stavanger
siblings.summary: Stavanger has exactly one restaurant at 2-stars-or-above: RE-NAA, the city's only 3-star. There are zero 2-star options — the next 2-star in Norway is Kontrast in Oslo.

sources.title: Hello Stavanger 2026
sources.claim: Hello Stavanger 2026 runs October 21-22 at Tou Scene, gathering developers, designers, leaders for software talks and networking.

sources.title: ONS 2026
sources.claim: ONS 2026 runs August 24-27 in Stavanger with 72,000+ visitors, 1,100+ exhibitors, 1,150+ speakers under theme 'Courage'.

sources.title: ONS Technical Programme
sources.claim: ONS 2026 has a dedicated Digital Transformation theme covering 'Dare to go digital – beyond the business case', AI-driven operational excellence and breaking data barriers.

sources.title: HealthTech Festival 2026 — Stavanger
sources.claim: HealthTech Festival 2026 is a half-day event on September 10 at HelseCampus Stavanger focused on health-system efficiency, robotics and dual-use tech.

sources.title: Hello Stavanger 2026 — Sessionize CFP
sources.claim: Hello Stavanger 2026 CFP scope spans Agile, Architecture, Coding, DevOps, AI/LLM, Security, Testing, UX; CFP closed May 3 2026.

sources.title: European Robotics Forum 2026
sources.claim: European Robotics Forum 2026 ran March 23-27 in Stavanger with 1,000+ participants on theme 'Robotics for the blue economy and growth in space'.

sources.title: Energy Norway 2026 — University of Stavanger
sources.claim: Energy Norway 2026 ran April 28-29 at the University of Stavanger, organised by NCS2030 around subsurface energy, net-zero production and digitalisation.

sources.title: Nordic Edge Expo 2026
sources.claim: Nordic Edge Expo 2026 ran May 4-6 at Fiskepiren in Stavanger, focused on regenerative, resilient and inclusive smart communities.

sources.title: javaBin Stavanger
sources.claim: javaBin Stavanger is the Norwegian Java User Group's Stavanger chapter with 330 members hosting talks on Java and related tech.

sources.title: Stavanger Software Developers Meetup — calendar
sources.claim: Stavanger Software Developers Meetup is the largest generalist developer group in Stavanger with 667 members.

sources.title: Stavanger Security Hangout
sources.claim: Stavanger Security Hangout has 330 members and runs regular CTFs and infosec talks at The Irishman pub in Stavanger.

sources.title: Meetup — Stavanger technology groups
sources.claim: Active Stavanger tech meetup groups include Hello Stavanger, Security Hangout, AWS User Group, Agile Meetup, Smart City (IoT), and Cyber Security for Control Systems.

sources.title: Hello Stavanger meetup
sources.claim: The Hello Stavanger meetup group has 279 members and runs satellite community events tied to the main conference.

sources.title: Hello Stavanger 2024 — venue page
sources.claim: Hello Stavanger launched in October 2024 as the first software conference in Stavanger, held at Tou Scene — a former brewery in Stavanger East, ~10 minutes' walk from the city centre.

sources.title: EIC Summit 2026 (Brussels)
sources.claim: EIC Summit 2026 takes place June 3-4 in Brussels (Tour & Taxis), not Stavanger, despite appearing on the Stavanger Region partner calendar.

sources.title: Stavanger Forum
sources.claim: Stavanger Forum — primary venue for ONS and other large conferences.

sources.title: Tou Scene
sources.claim: Tou Scene — former brewery in Stavanger East, venue for Hello Stavanger.
